text:
maria (Docs): Drafting relnotes for the 0.9.0 release. Primary asks: short feature blurb, 1-2 code examples for SDK, one migration note for quantized model support, and a 'known issues' bullet. Can folks drop snippets and callouts?

sam (PM): TL;DR: ship per-route latency breakdown + Optimize batch recommendations UI. Add note that Dedicated autoscale now supports burst configs.

kai (Eng): For the runtime changes, add that kv-cache persistence improved warm-starts for long-chat sessions. No breaking API changes.

alex (DevEx): I'll update JS + Python snippets. Quick check — do we prefer using the new streaming helper or old poll loop in examples?

emma (Docs): Streaming helper is preferred. Example should show partial tokens and finalization. I can draft a short JS example.

jen (QA): Known issue: streaming can drop final token when using client-side gzip + streaming responses. Repro steps: enable gzip on client, request streaming for >512 tokens, sometimes last frame missing. I'll add logs.

nora (DocsOps): Also we have ~7 legacy redirects for /sdk/js -> /sdk/javascript that 404 in the docs site. Can someone run the redirect sweep? Priority low but include in 'docs housekeeping' relnote.

maria (Docs): Great — action items: alex send snippets, emma post the streaming example, jen attach repro logs and a minimal test case, nora run redirects fix PR and link here. I'll craft the short blurbs.

alex (DevEx): Pushing two snippets in a branch now. JS streaming snippet:
```
const stream = client.responses.stream({ model: 'redwood-2', input: 'Summarize...' });
for await (const chunk of stream) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.text);
}
```
Python snippet (sync):
```
resp = client.responses.create(model='redwood-2', input='Summarize...')
print(resp.output_text)
```

emma (Docs): Inline migration blurb for quantization:
- If you pin to a quantized model (q4-level), ensure tokenization configuration matches your previous float model. Some tokenizers produce different offsets causing eval diffs. Suggest running eval-suite before rollout.

jen (QA): Attached minimal repro gist: https://gist.github.com/jen/stream-drop
I'll add CI test that toggles gzip and runs streaming for 1024 tokens.

nora (DocsOps): Redirect PR created: #4127. I listed the 7 paths and target slugs. Deploy preview passed :white_check_mark:

release-bot: Release window scheduled for 2026-04-09 17:00 UTC. Release candidate tag: v0.9.0-rc3

sam (PM): For the relnotes bullets, keep them short. Proposed copy:
- Per-route latency breakdown now visible in Console (beta).
- Optimize: Batch & cache suggestion UI simplifies cost tuning.
- Dedicated autoscale supports burst capacity for short spikes.
- Migration note: quantized models may require tokenization checks.
- Known issue: streaming + gzip may drop final token (see repro).

maria (Docs): Perfect. I'll draft the final relnotes and attach to the release PR. Requesting approvals: emma for examples, alex for SDK snippets, jen for known issue text, nora for redirect mention. Ping me when done :memo: :shipit: 

alex (DevEx): Snippets PR: #4130, includes updated code and a small note about streaming helper. CI green.

emma (Docs): Example PR: #4132. Added streaming example, short explanation, and rendered screenshots.

jen (QA): Known issue note approved. CI test added in #4134.

nora (DocsOps): Redirect PR merged. CDN purge scheduled.

maria (Docs): All approvals in. I'll merge relnotes draft and attach to v0.9.0-rc3. Thanks team! :tada:
